# Bobber Run â€?a free cozy pixel-art sailing & fishing browser game

> https://bobber.run â€?play free in your browser, no download, no account needed.

## What this game is

Bobber Run is a cozy pixel-art game about sailing a voxel sea and fishing. You start in a rowboat at Alderhaven, a faded harbour town, and fish, sell your catch, upgrade boats and rebuild the town one project at a time. Out in the far waters pirates sail from hidden coves: pay tribute, run upwind, or fight broadside-to-broadside.

It runs entirely in the browser (WebGL2, Preact UI). Voxel models are drawn back down to chunky pixels for the pixel-art look.

## Things players ask about

- **Is it free?** Completely free, no ads, nothing to buy with real money. The game's coins are earned by playing.
- **Do I need to download or sign up?** No. Guests sail within seconds; an optional free account only adds cloud saves, world records and cross-device progress.
- **What is there to do?** Fish 25+ species; sail between ports and take delivery contracts; arm your boat with broadside guns, mortars and fire shot, or buy warships from a Revenue Cutter to an Aircraft Carrier; dig buried treasure; raid pirate coves; send out a fishing fleet; finish quests; unlock boats from rowboat to Ocean Liner.
- **Can I turn off the pirates?** Yes â€?Settings has a pirates switch, and battle aids are on by default.
- **Multiplayer?** Optional online play shows other sailors on your sea, chat, world records and a coastwide fund. The game also runs fully offline.
- **Controls?** Keyboard, mouse and gamepads; every key is rebindable. Pixel style (Chunky/Crisp/Smooth) is a setting.
- **Is it open source?** Yes, MIT license. Upstream by iza (izadoesdev); this deployment runs at bobber.run.
